name: parallax-scroll-2
title: Rotated Parallax Grid
description: Three columns of photo tiles whose outer two lean and travel sideways as the box scrolls, one clockwise and one anticlockwise, while the middle one stays upright. It reads as a leaning gallery wall.
use: A showcase needs a bolder, more editorial take on a scrolling photo wall.
avoid: Photos must stay level and fully visible, or you need captions and keyboard scrolling.
a11y: Every image uses the alt text "thumbnail", and the rotation and translation ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A three-column wall of rounded photo tiles on black whose outer columns sit at visible angles. The photos show a forest at sunset, a hand holding a device, a red-and-yellow striped facade, a snow-capped peak, a couple on a bench in golden light and a hazy shoreline.
behaves: Scrolling moves the outer columns upward and inward while rotating them further, the left one anticlockwise and the right clockwise, so the wall shears and the rows cross. The middle column stays straight, and everything returns when you scroll back.
customise: images is a flat URL list split evenly into the three columns, and className restyles the scroll box. The forty-rem height, 200px shifts and 20-degree tilt are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Nine images whose translate and rotate offsets a scroll transform updates.
